title: Electric Twingo: what the name still keeps from the original spirit
author: Caramagnols
excerpt: Switching to electric power is not enough to remake a Twingo. What matters is what Renault does or does not retain from the original idea: a clear, urban and easy-to-live-with small car.
content:
The return of the Twingo name in an electrified landscape only makes sense if one looks beyond nostalgia. The real question is what Renault is actually trying to extend from the original spirit.

What the original car established

The first Twingo did not matter only because of its silhouette. It established a small car organised around space, simplicity and a less solemn tone than many rivals.

If the name is to be reused, that grammar deserves to be read first.

Why Renault keeps the name

An old name is not valuable only as memory. It also signals a continuity of position: city use, compact format, ease of use and the idea of a car less intimidating than others.

Seen that way, Twingo remains one of Renault’s most logical names for a small electric city car.

Can the Twingo spirit survive electrification

The answer depends less on the motor than on the project. If the car stays clear, compact, welcoming and shaped for ordinary life, the spirit can remain. If the name is only decoration, it fades quickly.

The real issue is therefore not to recreate 1993. It is to recover the same accuracy of use in another technical context.

This note extends the page the story of the Renault Twingo. Within the same cluster, the next useful step is Renault Twingo 1993: a simple launch that breaks with its era.
